notes.title: Discord!
notes.content:
[h1]Station Unknown is already on Steam![/h1]

[h2]Join our Discord![/h2]

You can get to know our team, our plans and be part of the new community!
We will soon announce a contest on our Discord! 
Keep an eye on our social media for news and upcoming events that will bring you closer to your night shift at "Station Unknown"!
